papers.title_en: CoTacWAM: Joint Modeling of Vision and Touch for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Lei Jin, Yiding Ma, Zhuohang Li, Jiachen Liu, Zibo Zhu, Kairui Liu, Chen Gao, Wei Wu, Yong Li
papers.evidence: 机器人世界动作模型融合腕部视觉与触觉的接触语义以支持操作
papers.tldr: 机器人操作需要同时理解腕部视角下的局部几何和实际触觉接触，而部分传感器缺失时仍应保持可靠交互。CoTacWAM提出视觉与触觉联合建模的世界动作模型，在共享接触语义的同时保留各模态独有证据，并结合头部视角的场景上下文进行预测式动作学习。实验在多种操作及缺失输入评估中取得较好表现，说明融合视觉与触觉可为机器人交互提供更完整且具适应性的接触表征。
papers.abstract_en: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

papers.title_en: RecallFlow: Episodic Memory as the Source Distribution of Generative Robot Policies
papers.authors: Xuji Zhang, Qilin Zhong, Zichen Zhang, Wei Zhai, Jian Di, Kun Li, Yang Cao, Wenjun Lv
papers.evidence: 将情景记忆用于生成式机器人操控策略
papers.tldr: 在记忆依赖型机器人操控中，目标可能已不在当前视野，策略必须从历史观察中找回相关信息；然而冗长历史容易引入虚假关联，传统生成策略从无信息的高斯噪声起步也缺乏记忆引导。RecallFlow将情景记忆作为生成策略的源分布，使动作采样起点携带已观察到的信息。该设计旨在提升机器人依赖记忆执行操控任务时的决策可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-matching policies have become a standard choice for visuomotor imitation learning, owing to their ability to model multimodal action distributions. In memory-dependent manipulation, the robot must act on information that is no longer visible. Existing methods feed the observation history to the policy as an additional condition, while action generation still starts from Gaussian noise. However, the policy must then pick out the relevant target from a long and redundant history, leading to spurious correlations and unreliable decisions as the memory load grows. Additionally, the initial noise carries no information about what the robot has seen, leaving generation without guidance toward the remembered target. To address these issues, we propose RecallFlow, a flow-policy framework that builds the source distribution from episodic memory. Recall-Relocalization relates the memory to the current view through a few recall slots, so that the source reflects where the remembered targets are now. Recall Anchors then turns each slot into a Gaussian component of the source, enabling generation to start close to the intended action instead of from noise. The transport network then completes the action from the current observation alone, keeping inference nearly as cheap as a memoryless policy. We further build a suite of memory-dependent tasks grouped by memory load and compare all policies under a matched protocol. Extensive experiments show that RecallFlow achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 80.4% on the public MIKASA-Robo memory benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 20.3 points on our suite and by 18.8 points on four real-robot tasks.

papers.title_en: RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Apoorva Vashisth, Manav Kulshrestha, Damon Conover, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 具身机器人操作中的长时程执行与重规划
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型能够执行短时程操作，但在包含多个相互依赖步骤的长任务中，规划、记忆、进度跟踪和错误恢复会使策略表现下降。RePlan-VLA采用与具体模型无关的执行框架，监测机器人运动以判断任务进展，并据此自适应修订后续计划。其设计将长任务拆解为可监控的短程执行与重规划环节，旨在提高具身操作完成复杂任务时的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

papers.title_en: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Amani Kiruga, Mark Hamilton, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, William T. Freeman, Vincent Sitzmann, Yilun Du, Ayush Tewari
papers.evidence: 针对单目图像进行稳健三维重建
papers.tldr: 现有前馈三维重建网络虽推断快速，却可能在训练分布之外的场景和陌生视角下失效。Infer3D转而采用逆生成建模，从单目图像中优化生成模型的潜变量，并结合冻结的三维提升网络，避免生成退化的平坦结果。该方法借助生成式先验进行自适应推断，旨在提升复杂条件下的三维结构恢复能力，为提高学习式重建的泛化鲁棒性提供了不同于纯前馈预测的思路。
papers.abstract_en: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. Across a variety of controlled synthetic and real-world tasks, Infer3D demonstrates superior OOD reconstruction accuracy compared to feedforward networks trained on equal or larger datasets. Furthermore, mirroring how human perception requires more time to process confusing stimuli, we introduce an adaptive inference strategy that expends more test-time compute on ambiguous OOD examples while efficiently routing in-distribution inputs. Project website: https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/

papers.title_en: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
papers.authors: Nico Leuze, Samed Dogan, Maximilian Hoh, Henry Schaub, Alfred Schöttl
papers.evidence: 稀疏多视角RGB-D位姿估计面向机器人料箱抓取与物体操作
papers.tldr: 工业料箱抓取需要在遮挡、杂乱及反光无纹理物体条件下准确估计位姿，而多阶段方法常有较高运行开销。SCCV-6D提出全稀疏的整体式多视角RGB-D估计器，并通过分阶段热图机制逐步剔除背景，以稀疏表示恢复精细三维空间。论文强调毫米级空间精度及部署效率，目标是在工业约束下实现可靠的物体定位，为机器人抓取提供感知基础。
papers.abstract_en: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.

papers.title_en: AGE-Capture: Autonomous, General, and Efficient UAV Capture for High-Fidelity Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Xiaofeng Jin, Ningbo Bu, Matteo Frosi, Yiran Guo, Weilun Ren, Matteo Matteucci
papers.evidence: 主动规划无人机观测以完成高保真场景重建
papers.tldr: 利用无人机进行高保真场景重建时，系统不仅要寻找有价值的视角，还需在传感器配置各异、飞行资源有限的条件下自主采集并判断任务进度。本文提出AGE-Capture主动采集框架，在线估计候选视角效用和重建完成情况，并以统一相机射线接口适配不同传感器。框架将几何探索与重建观测解耦，在真实无人机上实现自主飞行采集，为资源受限的场景重建提供了通用方案。
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity scene reconstruction with an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) requires more than identifying valuable viewpoints: the system must autonomously acquire informative observations and determine task completion under different sensing configurations and limited flight resources. We present AGE-Capture, an autonomous, sensor-adaptive, and efficient active-capture framework for real UAVs. Building on renderability, the framework uses a lightweight online state to evaluate the utility of candidate views, assess task progress, and guide flight execution. By decoupling geometric exploration from reconstruction observations and establishing a unified camera-ray interface, the framework allows different range sensors and RGB camera models to share a reconstruction-driven acquisition pipeline. Reconstruction-frontier viewpoints characterize residual acquisition value for region screening and autonomous termination; dynamics-aware hierarchical planning combined with asynchronous event-driven capture reduces unnecessary inter-region motion, time spent waiting for plans, and repeated observations. Across ten indoor and outdoor simulation scenes, AGE-Capture achieves a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) $3.30$--$3.53\,\mathrm{dB}$ higher than that of the online baselines while using $58.2\%$ of the common mission-time budget on average. Its mean peak GPU memory usage is $91.0\%$--$93.3\%$ lower than that of the same baselines. Experiments with different sensor configurations validate the adaptability of the shared acquisition pipeline, while flights in nine real-world scenes further demonstrate onboard closed-loop operation under practical computational and motion constraints.

papers.title_en: TSIR: Ray-Traced Triangle Splats for Inverse Rendering
papers.authors: Wentao Yang, Chentao Shen, Zhengqi Zhang, Bolin Chen, Yan Ye, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 从多视图图像重建可重照明的三角形溅射表面，直接涉及表面恢复
papers.tldr: 高斯基元重叠会使表面恢复复杂化，并增加逆渲染中多层遍历与合成的成本。TSIR从多视图图像重建可重照明的三角形溅射表面，先建立带可学习顶点着色法线的基元，再直接追踪表面并用蒙特卡洛积分估计材质。实验报告其重照明质量优于所比较方法，同时减少对多层合成的依赖，为表面表示与逆渲染结合提供了方案。
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering enables realistic relighting for visual effects and augmented reality. However, overlapping Gaussian primitives complicate surface recovery and require costly multi-layer traversal and compositing for light transport. We propose TSIR, a two-stage inverse rendering method that reconstructs relightable triangle splats from multi-view images. The first stage prepares opaque triangle splats with learnable vertex shading normals. The second stage directly traces these surfaces to estimate materials through Monte Carlo integration of direct illumination and indirect reflections, reducing reliance on multi-layer compositing. Anti-aliasing improves rendering quality while maintaining efficiency. Experiments demonstrate higher relighting quality than the evaluated baselines and more efficient anti-aliasing than supersampling.

papers.title_en: LiDAR Signals for Robot Locomotion: Spherical Range Images Enable Robust Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.authors: Nian Liu, Xinyi Tong, Ming Ren, Long Ye, Zhaofeng He
papers.evidence: 通过激光雷达感知支持机器人运动及仿真到现实迁移。
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人依赖深度图或在线高程图时，容易受到仿真与现实传感差异、地图漂移等问题影响。本文提出激光雷达感知流程，在传感器采样和表示层面对齐仿真与实机，并以球面距离图组织周围几何。该方法旨在为高频运动控制提供稳定、紧凑的环境输入，增强机器人在真实环境中的运动可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Existing legged-locomotion systems commonly rely on depth images or online elevation maps. However, depth-based policies suffer from perceptual sim-to-real discrepancies due to imperfect depth sensor modeling, while map-based approaches are vulnerable to drift and misalignment. LiDAR offers direct measurements of the surrounding geometry, but raw LiDAR scans lack a compact, structured representation for high-frequency control. We propose a LiDAR perception pipeline that maintains perceptual consistency across simulation and reality through sensing- and representation-level alignment. At the sensor level, we recover frame-wise angular sampling patterns from the physical LiDAR and replay them in simulation with GPU ray casting. At the representation level, simulated and real returns undergo the same spherical range image encoding, yielding a fixed-size policy observation for end-to-end training and direct deployment without teacher--student distillation, online elevation mapping, or adaptation. Experiments show that our range-image policies achieve stronger sim-to-real transfer than depth- and elevation-map-based baselines, while ablations confirm the importance of the proposed sensing components. More visualizations and real-world videos are available at the \href{https://lidar-img.github.io/}

papers.title_en: DiffSimp: Differentiable Mesh Simplification for Gradient-Based Low-Poly Modeling
papers.authors: Seonghun Oh
papers.evidence: 可微QEM网格简化可改进几何优化与网格生成流程。
papers.tldr: 几何优化流程通常在完成后才简化网格，因此简化造成的误差无法反向影响最终模型。论文提出DiffSimp，将基于二次误差度量的并行边折叠构造成可微、免训练的简化层，并在固定折叠历史下定义局部可微映射以传播梯度。这样既保留离散折叠决策，又能将简化纳入上游优化。该方法可直接改进低多边形建模与网格处理流程。
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable mesh extraction enables gradient-based optimization of detailed 3D geometry across diverse tasks. However, compact meshes are commonly obtained through post-processing simplification, leaving simplification-induced errors outside upstream optimization. We introduce DiffSimp, a training-free, drop-in differentiable mesh simplification layer built on QEM-based parallel edge collapse, enabling existing geometry optimization pipelines to optimize their final simplified meshes. We formulate simplification under a fixed collapse history as a locally differentiable collapse map, enabling gradient propagation without relaxing discrete collapse decisions. We combine fast, high-quality parallel simplification with a factorized backward formulation that exploits differentiable vertex quadrics and quadric reduction forests for efficient gradient propagation. Experiments on low-poly mesh reconstruction and inverse rendering demonstrate improved fidelity over post-processing simplification, with additional gains from gradient propagation that increase under tighter vertex budgets. DiffSimp supports diverse geometry optimization frontends, with 1.00-1.25$\times$ the end-to-end runtime of unsimplified baselines in evaluated pipelines.

papers.title_en: DuCo: Exploiting Dual Cross-Layer Consistency for Sparse Geometric Attention
papers.authors: Liangyu Xiang, Junyu Gao, Xiaofeng Wang, Changsheng Xu
papers.evidence: 利用跨层一致性改进几何视觉基础模型的稀疏注意力
papers.tldr: 视觉几何基础模型依赖密集全局注意力捕获跨视角几何，但长序列推理会受到二次复杂度限制，既有稀疏方法也忽略了层间信息复用。DuCo分析不同层的注意力分布与值表示冗余，发现注意力模式高度相似、值冗余结构仅局部变化，并据此构建跨层稀疏注意力。该设计减少重复计算，同时保留几何推理所需的关键信息，为几何视觉模型扩展到更长图像序列提供效率改进。
papers.abstract_en: Dense global attention is crucial for capturing cross-view geometry in visual geometry foundation models, yet its quadratic complexity limits efficient inference on long image sequences. Existing sparse attention methods primarily select entries of the global attention matrix based on attention probabilities and construct masks independently across layers, overlooking value redundancy and cross-layer information reuse. By analyzing attention distributions and clustering value representations across layers, we reveal two forms of \emph{cross-layer consistency}, characterized by highly similar attention probability distributions and localized changes in value redundancy structures. Building on these observations, we propose \textbf{DuCo}, a training-free sparse attention framework that exploits historical attention information and value redundancy for efficient geometric inference. Specifically, DuCo leverages historical attention information to estimate current-layer dense attention probabilities and introduces value clustering to exploit redundancy, with clusters efficiently refined through local updates across layers. Both factors are integrated through probability-weighted value distortion to jointly optimize four cluster representation states under an attention budget for sparse mask construction. Experiments across three visual geometry foundation models and five benchmarks demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs.

papers.title_en: HOForce: Motion and Force Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction Using a Single-View RGB-D Video
papers.authors: Jiahui Wang, Wanqing Du, Yuanbin Zou, Zhefeng Xu, Feng Xu
papers.evidence: 从RGB-D视频重建手物运动与接触力，服务于交互分析。
papers.tldr: 单视角捕捉手物交互便于规模化采集，但严重遮挡会导致手部和物体运动难以恢复，接触力也不易观测。HOForce利用RGB-D视频及已知物体属性跟踪手和物体，并联合估计双手指尖力以及物体间接触力；这些力约束还能帮助修正遮挡区域的姿态。实验在DexYCB和TACO等数据上显示运动恢复更准确，并减少手物穿透，为理解和建模机器人操作中的物理交互提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing hand-object interactions is an important task, and achieving it with a single camera makes large-scale capture practical but challenging due to heavy occlusions. We introduce HOForce to track hands and objects, and further recover interaction forces from single-view RGB-D video and known object properties. For two-hand manipulation, we jointly model fingertip forces of both hands and the contact forces between objects when two objects are presented. The reconstructed forces also improve motion tracking by giving pose constraints in the occluded regions. HOForce recovers hand and object motion more accurately on DexYCB and TACO and produces less hand-object penetration than interaction baselines on DexYCB. On our dataset of fingertip forces recorded with tactile sensors, HOForce reduces normal-force MAE by 24.5% relative to the strongest baseline. The recovered forces reproduce object motion in MuJoCo and transfer to other engines after adaptation.

papers.title_en: Effects of Locomotion and Viewpoint Control on Immersive Robot Telepresence for Navigation and Inspection
papers.authors: Ammaar Zaman, Neven ElSayed, Oliver Prentner, Mohamed Ellethy, Mostafa M. Lotfy, Maram Selsabila Mahmoudi, Eduardo Veas
papers.evidence: 参与者操控四足机器人穿越实体迷宫并执行标记定位与检查任务。
papers.tldr: 机器人远程呈现界面通常分别用手柄控制移动和视角，可能增加操作者在导航、观察与检查间切换的负担。本文让参与者佩戴虚拟现实头显操控四足机器人穿越实体迷宫，并以受试者内实验比较两种移动方式和两种相机控制方式。结果显示，头部引导相机控制与更快完成任务、更少墙面接触以及更低工作负荷相关，同时用户体验评价也更好。研究为实体环境中的机器人导航和远程检查提供了界面设计证据。
papers.abstract_en: In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

papers.title_en: LaST1.0: A Unified Latent World-Action Model with Control-Centric SpatioTemporal Reasoning
papers.authors: Hao Chen, Xuheng Zhang, Zhuangzhe Wu, Jiaming Liu, Shaobo Zhang, Jialin Gao, Zhonghao Yan, Di Wu, Sixiang Chen, Peng Jia, Chi-Wing Fu, Shanghang Zhang, Pheng-Ann Heng
papers.evidence: 机器人操作中的世界模型与几何感知动作预测
papers.tldr: 机器人操作的世界模型需要预测环境变化以支持控制，但重建完整未来视频会将大量容量用于与动作决策无关的外观细节。LaST1.0提出统一的潜在世界动作模型，在潜在空间进行控制中心的未来预测，并利用未来腕部视角提取几何相关目标，监督机器人与物体交互的演变。该设计将世界建模重点转向可行动的动态信息，为精细操作策略提供更直接的预测基础。
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models couple action learning with future prediction, enabling robotic policies to capture environmental dynamics for robust control. However, prevailing methods take a reconstruction-oriented approach to model future videos, allocating substantial capacity to appearance details that are incidental to control. In this work, we reformulate world modeling for manipulation as control-centric future prediction in latent space, and present LaST1.0, a unified latent World-Action Model. Rather than modeling an observation-complete video future, LaST1.0 predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets derived from future wrist views, focusing the supervision on the evolving robot-object interactions required for fine-grained manipulation. To better support this control-centric paradigm, LaST1.0 revisits the visual input interface and attention mechanism of its unified architecture. It adopts a vision-encoder-free design with a lightweight patch embedder, exposing fine-grained visual cues directly to the backbone, and introduces LaST-Attention for structured spatiotemporal interactions across modalities. Evaluations across two robot embodiments, five challenging manipulation tasks, and three simulation benchmarks---RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus---demonstrate that LaST1.0 achieves state-of-the-art success rates and generalizes to novel scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of control-centric latent world modeling for robust manipulation.

papers.title_en: SemPhys: Semantic-Physical Co-Learning for Humanoid Motion Generation via Differentiable World Models
papers.authors: Zejian Kang, Yeqiang Wang, Zekai Chen, Boyang Shen, Mingyu Ma, Bingqian Wu, Fan Zhou, Jianjie Zhang, Chentao Shen, Wentao Yang, Rui Qian, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 通过模拟执行反馈训练人形机器人动作生成
papers.tldr: 人形机器人根据自然语言生成全身动作时，常先产生运动学参考，再由控制器执行；平衡和接触约束可能使实际动作偏离参考，甚至改变动作表达的含义。SemPhys提出通过可微世界模型模拟完整执行过程，并将执行后的语义反馈用于训练动作生成器。该设计把语义对齐从理想轨迹评估转向真实可执行运动评估。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法直接回应了具身动作生成中语言意图与物理执行脱节的问题。
papers.abstract_en: In human-robot collaboration, natural language lets people direct a humanoid's whole-body movements without programming joint trajectories. A common approach generates a kinematic reference from an instruction and relies on a tracking controller to execute it. However, as the controller maintains balance under contact constraints, the executed motion can depart from the reference in ways that change the action it conveys. Our central insight is that semantic alignment must be evaluated directly on the complete motion the robot physically executes. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{SemPhys}, a framework that trains motion generators using semantic feedback from simulated executions. A differentiable world model and a fixed tracking controller predict a short segment of a recorded execution. SemPhys inserts this prediction at its original position, scores the complete trajectory against the instruction, and backpropagates through the predicted segment. A paired anchoring loss stabilizes adaptation by keeping each generated reference close to its counterpart from the initial generator. On BONES-SEED, SemPhys largely preserves instruction retrieval accuracy from reference to execution and achieves the highest retrieval accuracy on executed motions among the evaluated methods.

papers.title_en: Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.authors: Zongyuan Wu, Xin Wang, Tongtong Feng, Yuan Meng, Zeyang Zhang, Ling Feng, Wenwu Zhu
papers.evidence: 具身任务的关系世界模型与潜在动力学规划
papers.tldr: 具身智能体执行长时程任务时需要依赖世界模型进行想象式规划，但仅以密集像素建模会带来冗余，并忽略任务实体之间的重要关系，使误差在长预测序列中累积。本文探索以稀疏状态抽象构建关系世界模型，重点处理紧凑状态形成和实体关系表达问题。该方向面向具身及网页环境中的长期决策，旨在提升内部环境模型对规划的支持能力。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Embodied Graph, a relational state abstraction that supports structured dynamics modeling and long-horizon imagination, and the Relational World Model (RWM), which performs imagination directly over graph states. RWM consists of (i) a Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor that filters redundant details and maintains graph memory through online updates, and (ii) an Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model that learns node-wise latent dynamics while capturing inter-node dependencies. The imagined graph states provide predictions of action consequences to guide decision-making. Experiments on Minecraft and Crafter demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM in embodied environments. Notably, in Minecraft, RWM is the only method that obtains diamonds within the given budget. Experiments on web interaction further illustrate the applicability of relational state prediction to the decision making process of web agents.

papers.title_en: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
papers.authors: Zengle Zhu, Zhen Li, Tianyi Huai, Xinhu Zheng, Liuqing Yang, Rongqing Zhang
papers.evidence: 融合多智能体与多模态信息以联合表达三维场景占据、几何和语义
papers.tldr: 三维语义占据感知可同时表达场景几何与语义，但遮挡和传感器覆盖不足会造成空间信息缺失。CoopOcc利用多智能体协作补充观测，并通过跨模态融合整合互补的几何与语义特征，重点处理不同区域信息价值不均及跨主体对应关系问题。该方法面向更完整的三维场景理解，为协同感知中的语义与几何联合建模提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.

papers.title_en: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.authors: Yuxi Wang, Yufei Liu, Chengkai Jin, Qingyue Chen, Wenqi Ouyang, Tianyi Wei, Kerui Ren, Siyuan Huang, Zhiqi Shen, Hongsheng Li, Xingang Pan
papers.evidence: 从第一人称视频恢复度量三维手部运动以支持机器人操作学习
papers.tldr: 从第一人称人类视频学习机器人操作，需要准确的度量三维手部运动，但视频扩散模型直接回归深度时容易受相机变化影响，难以泛化。ViDiHand2将深度估计转化为几何约束求解，结合二维关节与MANO手部结构进行细粒度几何提升，并通过片段级射线拟合恢复尺度。该框架旨在提升野外视频中的手部运动重建可靠性，为从人类示范学习操作提供更稳健的三维信息。
papers.abstract_en: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The project page is available at https://vidihand2.github.io/.

papers.title_en: SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens
papers.authors: Sai Karthikey Pentapati, Shashank Nelamangala Sridhara, Birendra Kathariya, Peng Yin, Guandao Yang, Alan C. Bovik
papers.evidence: 以Transformer压缩并重新合成三维高斯场景表示
papers.tldr: 三维高斯泼溅支持实时渲染，但场景存储开销较大；传统压缩通常编码原有基元，或为每个场景单独优化表示。SplatTok提出跨场景训练的学习式重合成编解码器，由Transformer将输入泼溅编码为空间锚定的潜在词元，再由共享解码器生成新的标准高斯基元，而不强求与输入逐一对应。该方法利用不同基元布局可以产生相近视图的自由度，实现紧凑场景表示，为可扩展的三维场景存储和重建提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

papers.title_en: X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views
papers.authors: Zidian Qiu, Ancong Wu
papers.evidence: 从图像直接预测物体布局与尺度，组合可编辑三维场景
papers.tldr: 从图像构建可编辑三维场景时，物体资产可以由生成或检索得到，但如何将多个资产可靠地放置到场景中仍不易解决。X-3DComposer以图像、物体掩码及任意来源的资产为输入，将物体视作视图并在一次前馈处理中联合预测旋转、平移和各轴尺度。方法无需逐物体迭代布局，约一秒即可完成预测。它将场景布局与资产生成解耦，推动快速、灵活的三维场景组合。
papers.abstract_en: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.

papers.title_en: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
papers.authors: Yang Cao, Zhe Zhu, Yiheng Zhang, Zhengqiang Zhang, Haoyuan Li, Le Wan, Dan Xu
papers.evidence: 结合几何结构与语义上下文对三维对象进行部件分割
papers.tldr: 将三维对象划分为有意义的部件，需要同时理解几何结构和语义上下文，单一模型的区域提议或语义线索往往不足。PartAgent提出免训练的智能体式分割框架，将预训练三维专家提供的空间区域与二维专家的多视图语义证据结合，并通过图像到表面的对应关系进行融合，再以闭环方式逐步修正结果。论文聚焦对象部件而非完整场景分割，但其几何与语义协同及细粒度组件分解思路与层级场景理解相关。
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.

papers.title_en: EAGLE: Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding
papers.authors: Zhongjian Zou, Quan Qian
papers.evidence: 以实体为中心分层组织视觉证据，支持细粒度图像理解。
papers.tldr: 高分辨率图像理解中，局部细节容易与整体场景脱节，而且不同注意力头提供的定位信号可靠性不一。EAGLE先利用细粒度数据筛选视觉定位能力较强的注意力头，再提取目标实体相关区域，并构建分层视觉证据，通过问题引导的路由选择信息。该框架把实体局部与更广场景证据联系起来，有助于细粒度图像理解，但并非三维场景分割方法。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained understanding of high-resolution images: attention heads vary in their reliability for grounding target entities and their attributes, while localized details are often disconnected from the broader scene context. We propose EAGLE (Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding), a plug-in framework that jointly selects grounding signals and organizes hierarchical visual evidence. EAGLE employs a fine-grained dataset to screen visually-grounded attention heads, followed by entity-aware grounding to extract target-specific regions. It then integrates hierarchical evidence construction and question-guided routing to select optimal view combinations, feeding them into the frozen MLLM to enhance fine-grained visual understanding. Experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-8B demonstrate that EAGLE consistently improves performance across both backbones and achieves SOTA results on V*, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K compared with existing methods using the same backbone.

papers.title_en: GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame
papers.authors: Hanglei Jin, Chenglu Sun, Junchen Ge, Yuchao Wang, Siqi Chen, Yuzhi Huang, Jingyan Jiang, Zhi Wang
papers.evidence: 结合SLAM相机估计与人体网格恢复，改善动态相机下的全局三维一致性
papers.tldr: 单目视频中的动态相机运动会使人体网格恢复与SLAM产生的相机和轨迹估计方向不一致，并造成累积漂移。GravHMR通过共享重力对齐参考系耦合两类结果，并以偏航感知优化校正身体与速度方向；框架无需训练且可插接使用。该方法提升了相机运动条件下人体运动与世界坐标的一致性，体现了几何视觉中相机和三维形状联合处理的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.

papers.title_en: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Zhuoying Yang, Yichen Guo, Kathy Jia, Zichang Su, Ayesha Kashif, Nange Hai, Jeffrey Ming Han Li, Zhewen He, Silvio Kempf, Ni Jiachen, Junjie Yang, Muhammad Hamza, Zakaria El Ouahidi, Gabriel Azpitarte, Manling Li, Yi Fang, Shuhong Liu, Mengyu Wang
papers.evidence: 解析视觉潜在特征中的多视图空间证据与三维关系
papers.tldr: 多视图空间推理需要可靠的跨视图对应和场景几何，但视觉语言模型往往难以直接从图像中提取这些信息。本文提出无需训练的LatentParse，利用分析型视觉语言模型探查预训练视觉编码器中的特征，包括包含多视图几何信息的VGGT表示，并将潜在信息解析为显式空间证据。这样可将对象与图像区域的联系、跨视图语义匹配及几何线索提供给后续推理。该方法探索了复用视觉表征来增强多模态三维空间理解的途径。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

papers.title_en: HiGS: A Hierarchical Architecture for Fast Differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Dawid Pająk, Martin Bisson, Rodolfo Lima, François Trudel
papers.evidence: 分层三维高斯泼溅架构同时处理渲染与场景重建
papers.tldr: 三维高斯泼溅将屏幕图块同时用于空间划分、光栅化和并行计算，导致密集区域决定整体帧时间。HiGS采用分层图块架构，让高斯点按粗粒度宏图块划分，再在细粒度渲染图块中以有界、按深度排序的批次处理。重建也复用这些批次，使计算能随视图中的实际工作量分配。该设计为高效三维场景渲染与重建提供了统一架构。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) makes one screen tile the cell of partitioning, the cell of rasterization, and the unit of parallel work. Partitioning favors large tiles and rasterization small ones, and with one unit per tile the densest tiles set the frame time. We present Hierarchically Tiled Gaussian Splatting (HiGS), a unified architecture for rendering and reconstruction that gives each role its own granularity: Gaussians are partitioned over coarse macro-tiles, rasterized over the fine render tiles within them, and processed in bounded depth-sorted batches. A dense region issues more batches instead of one longer unit, so frame time follows the work in a view rather than its densest tile. The same batches carry reconstruction: compositing supplies the transmittance and color needed to differentiate each one independently, leaving optimizer memory traffic as the dominant training cost. We fuse the optimizer into the backward pass, halve the parameters and moments it stores and updates directly, and defer appearance updates outside the view. HiGS renders scenes faster than every published method we evaluate, by the widest margin on views with uneven load, and reconstructs them faster and in less memory, at equal image quality and with exact front-to-back alpha compositing.

papers.title_en: PRC4D: Physical Relation-Constrained Persistent 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Junho Kim, Hyunyoung Choi, Jiseok Kim, Seongwon Lee
papers.evidence: 利用物理关系约束维持遮挡期间四维重建的空间一致性。
papers.tldr: 物体被遮挡时，四维重建需要延续其形状与运动；但若把短暂接触或共同运动误认为持久刚性关系，重建就会产生错误约束并发生形变。PRC4D结合三维接触、相对运动一致性和序列级验证，筛选可信的刚性关系。随后利用这些关系维持遮挡期间的空间一致性与运动延续，旨在提升动态场景重建的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: A faithful 4D reconstruction should capture both the shape and motion of objects, even when they disappear from view. Existing methods preserve previously observed geometry and extend motion through occlusion using local spatial and motion associations. However, treating short-term contact or shared motion as sufficient evidence of persistent rigidity can introduce incorrect motion constraints and distort overall reconstruction. To address this limitation, we present PRC4D, a physical relation-constrained framework that identifies reliable rigid relations and uses them to maintain spatial consistency through occlusion. PRC4D combines 3D contact and relative motion consistency with sequence-level verification to distinguish persistent couplings from transient interactions. The resulting graph guides observed-pose refinement and motion propagation from visible to occluded components without altering reconstructed geometry. Experiments on diverse real-world multi-object sequences and controlled occlusion simulations demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy, reduced relative pose errors, and more consistent object configurations under changing visibility.
